papers.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.problem: AI models that see an image still lose track of items when they count or reason in steps.
papers.fix: Right numbered markers on the image raised accuracy by up to 25%; wrong markers helped little or hurt.
papers.practicalUseCase: Models fail at pointing, not seeing, so add task-matched markers to your image prompts before you retrain anything.
papers.limitation: The tests used five fixed visual reasoning tasks, so other tasks may behave differently.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
papers.problem: Self-teaching training for language models often stops improving because the model gives bad guidance on some samples.
papers.fix: Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation improves the teacher and ignores bad guidance, beating other methods across datasets and model sizes.
papers.practicalUseCase: Training quality depends on guidance quality, so check and filter the teacher signal before you scale up training.
papers.limitation: The abstract gives no exact gains, so the size of the improvement is unclear.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Nobody knew how sustainability sukuk issuance grew or what makes an issue larger.
papers.fix: Across 11,944 sukuk, growth centred in Indonesia, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia, and equity-based contracts gave larger issues.
papers.practicalUseCase: Issuers who want bigger sustainability sukuk should use equity-based contracts, strong security and major currencies, and watch second-party opinion costs.
papers.limitation: The data stops at 2022 and shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategies to Enhance Islamic Banks’ Competitiveness and Sustainable Development
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Islamic banks in Jordan lacked proof that AI and big data improve their competitiveness and sustainability.
papers.fix: In a survey of 214 managers, AI, big data and data management all linked to better competitiveness and sustainability.
papers.practicalUseCase: Islamic banks that invest in AI and data management compete better, but staff digital skill did not lift sustainability.
papers.limitation: The survey covers one country at one time, so it shows links, not cause.

papers.title: ICT, High-Tech Exports, and Institutions as Drivers of Bank Expansion Growth in a Dual Banking System
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks did not know which national factors drive expansion in countries with both Islamic and conventional banks.
papers.fix: In 218 banks, ICT adoption drove expansion most, and high-tech exports helped only when combined with ICT.
papers.practicalUseCase: Banks and regulators should put digital infrastructure first, because strong ICT boosts growth in both Islamic and conventional banks.
papers.limitation: The data covers 12 countries from 2010 to 2023, so results may differ elsewhere.

papers.title: Determinants of Financial Inclusion in the OIC and OECD Countries: Are They Different?
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.institution: International Centre for Education in Islamic Finance
papers.problem: Many people in Muslim-majority countries still lack formal financial services, despite fast growth in Islamic finance.
papers.fix: Across 35 countries, income, education, institutions and internet access drive inclusion in OIC countries.
papers.practicalUseCase: OIC countries should invest in digital infrastructure, youth and women, and income growth to bring more people into banks.
papers.limitation: The data runs 2005 to 2021 and shows links between factors, not cause.

papers.title: Sustainability Committees and Environmental Initiatives: Insights from Dual Banking Systems in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks set up sustainability committees, but nobody knew if they change environmental results in Islamic banks.
papers.fix: Committees raised all four green measures overall, but in Islamic banks they moved only overall and resource scores.
papers.practicalUseCase: Committees alone may give Islamic banks symbolic gains, so regulators should also check for real green products and innovation.
papers.limitation: The study shows links in emerging markets and cannot prove the committee caused the change.

papers.title: Procrastination among US college students: Prevalence and impact relative to common health and life issues
papers.problem: Nobody knew how common student procrastination is next to other health and life problems.
papers.fix: Among 65,950 US students, 72.3% procrastinated, and 45.4% said it hurt grades, far more than finances or ADHD.
papers.practicalUseCase: Delay hurts grades more than most other problems, so fix your starting habits first.
papers.limitation: The data is self-reported by US college students, so it may not fit workers or other countries.

papers.title: “The significance of context”: Fit, friction, and function in the work lives of early career academics with ADHD
papers.problem: Little is known about how ADHD affects early-career academics at work.
papers.fix: Interviews showed academia can reward ADHD traits, but social and institutional pressure often blocks that.
papers.practicalUseCase: Choose workplaces and managers that fit how you work, and ask for fit instead of forcing yourself to match.
papers.limitation: The study is interviews only, so it shows personal experience, not how common these views are.
